title: odd-combobox
description: An editable input with a popup listbox (APG combobox, list autocomplete): typing filters the options and the first match becomes active; Enter or a click chooses. With `multiple`, chosen values are chips in the field, collapsed to "+N" while the field is not in use. Options come from `<option>` and `<optgroup>` children, written as for a native select, or from `options`.
$comment: Slots: "empty", "status". A child names a slot with "slot"; text and children without "slot" go to the default slot.

name.description: Name submitted with the form. Reflected: a form-associated element submits under its name attribute.

error.description: Error message; marks the field invalid (custom validity) while set.

value.description: Value of the selected option; the `value` attribute sets the default.

required.description: An option must be selected to submit.

loading.description: Shows a busy row and marks the options busy.

view.description: With `multiple`, how the chosen values show in the field: chips ("+N" for those that do not fit), a count, a sentence (`text`), chips up to four and then the count (`auto`), two rows of chips with Show all (`expandable`), initials (`avatars`), or a count per group (`grouped`).

select-all.description: With `multiple` and options, a "Select all" check box above them: it chooses every usable option shown, or clears them when all are chosen.

review.description: With `multiple`, the open popup starts with the chosen values: "Selected (N)", a disclosure of the first three, each removable, and View N more.

readonly.description: The value shows but cannot be changed; it is still submitted.

placeholder.description: Text shown in the empty input.

no-filter.description: The element does not filter: listen to `odd-query-change` and replace `options` with the matches.

values.description: Values of the selected options with `multiple`.

strings.description: Localized string overrides; `remove` takes `{label}` and `more` takes `{count}`.
